rows.summary: Kafka broker-0 (lakehouse-dual-role-0) is Running/Ready at the pod level but its Prometheus metrics endpoint is unreachable, 60 partitions are under-replicated, and all this correlates with a Chaos Mesh deployment ~133 minutes ago — an active network-disruption experiment almost certainly isolating broker-0's data-plane. The runbook explicitly says do NOT restart a network-isolated broker; escalate to whoever owns the chaos experiment.

Chaos Mesh experiment killed all Kafka/Flink pods ~129 min ago (exit 255/Unknown); brokers recovered but lakehouse-dual-role-0's metrics endpoint is still unreachable, keeping the KafkaBrokerDown alert firing. 60 under-replicated partitions; 0 offline; cluster still serving, but no margin left.

Broker lakehouse-dual-role-0 is Running/Ready but its metrics endpoint is unreachable, keeping the KafkaBrokerDown alert firing. 60 partitions remain under-replicated and active_controller count reads 0. The root cause is a Chaos Mesh experiment deployed ~133 minutes ago that caused all three brokers (and Flink) to terminate (exit 255/Unknown); broker-0 has not fully rejoined since—likely a lingering network fault from the experiment.
